evals.prompt: Build a landing page for Loamly, a soil-testing kit for home gardeners that mails results to an app. No brand yet. Make it not look like every other AI site.
evals.expected_output: States a one-line Design Read and a use-scene sentence, picks a named direction with a subject-derived reason and one signature move, writes a token plan (4-6 named OKLCH/hex colors with roles, typefaces with roles and a scale ratio, radius, motion budget, ASCII wireframe with alignment), runs an explicit default check that names what was changed, then builds without fabricated proof and lists placeholders.
expectations: Output contains a Design Read line naming surface, audience, and job before any code
Output names exactly one signature move
Token plan lists between 4 and 6 named colors, each with a role
Output contains a default check that states what the reflex version would have been and what was changed
No accent hue in the indigo/violet band and no purple gradient unless justified in writing
Display font is not Inter, Geist, Space Grotesk, or Instrument Serif without a stated reason
No invented testimonials, customer logos, or metrics; any placeholders are listed for the user
Eyebrow labels or 01/02/03 markers appear only where content is a real category or sequence

evals.prompt: Our SaaS marketing site feels generic and dated. Here's the repo. Make it look premium but don't break anything.
evals.expected_output: Chooses Refine vs Overhaul explicitly (defaults to Refine or asks once), audits before changing (stack, brand assets, IA/URLs, SEO baseline, analytics IDs), applies levers in order typography, spacing, color, states, motion, lists anything on the never-change-silently list as needing approval, and reports before/after with screenshots or 'Not checked visually'.
expectations: States the redesign mode (Refine or Overhaul) before editing
Produces an audit covering URLs/nav labels and SEO or analytics baseline before making changes
Does not change URLs, nav labels, form field names, logo, or legal copy without flagging them for approval
Changes are ordered starting with typography and spacing rather than block replacement
Final report separates Changed, Preserved, and Not checked

evals.prompt: Make it brutalist: black and white, huge Helvetica headlines, zero border radius, no animations. It's a poster archive for a design school.
evals.expected_output: Follows the explicit brief exactly (the brief's words win), uses the brutalist preset values, does not argue the user out of Helvetica or pure black/white, and still enforces contrast, focus visibility, and reading order.
expectations: Uses Helvetica (or the requested face), radius 0, and no motion as requested
Does not replace the user's explicit choices with the skill's own preferences
Keeps visible keyboard focus and WCAG AA text contrast
Does not add decorative gradients, glows, or entrance animations

evals.prompt: What's the right line-height and max width for body text in our docs site?
evals.expected_output: Near-miss: answers directly with numbers (line-height about 1.5-1.7, measure about 65ch) or defers to design-foundations; does not run the full direction workflow, token plan, or default check.
expectations: Gives concrete values for line-height and measure
Does not produce a Design Read, direction preset, or signature move for this question
